disposition_reason: Primary MP-AES analysis of ten retail white wheat flours; essential elements quantified, Pb, Cd and As reported not detected.

study.design: Retail survey of local and imported white wheat flour
study.origin: 5 locally produced (Kosovo) and 5 imported (countries not stated)
study.method: Microwave HNO3/H2O2 digestion of 0.50 g (ETHOS 900); MP-AES (Agilent 4200)
study.qa: none reported (no CRM, recovery, blanks or LOD)

controls.control: Sourcing: imported vs locally produced flour
controls.outcome: Fe 10.25 -> 20.38 mg/kg and Cu 1.67 -> 1.90 mg/kg (p < 0.05); Pb, Cd, As not detected in either

unresolved: No LOD/LOQ reported, so the non-detects for Pb, Cd and As cannot be bounded; MP-AES detection limits are typically well above the low ug/kg levels of Cd and Pb in flour.
Digestion volumes are given twice inconsistently (8 mL HNO3 + 2 mL H2O2 vs 6 mL + 1 mL).
Reference list contains a placeholder DOI ("10.21608/ejchem.2023.XXXXX") and a reference with no authors, suggesting weak editorial checks.
EU limits quoted in Table 4 (Cu 10, Zn 50, As 0.20 mg/kg for flour) do not correspond to EU contaminant regulation entries; Pb 0.20 and Cd 0.10 match EU cereal limits.

regulatory_or_exposure.what: EU limits as quoted by the authors for flour
regulatory_or_exposure.value: Pb 0.20, Cd 0.10, As 0.20, Cu 10, Zn 50 mg/kg
